Roughly 70,000 US rooftops first, then every market where dealers sell cars. You work agents-first. A small team that ships like a large one, with AI doing the repetitive work. Your work lands on a dealer\'s PL. Every agent you activate answers calls, books service and helps move cars faster. 
 
 What You'll Own 
 
 01. Own the funnel, end to end (Full-funnel growth) 
 From 'saw it on LinkedIn' to 'we can\'t run the store without it'. Instrument every step: visit, signup, first agent live, first paid month, second agent added. Find the biggest leak every week and fix it with Product, Design and Engineering. Ship 10+ experiments a month across pricing pages, onboarding, trials and offers, with a written verdict on each. Run the weekly growth review: what moved, why, and what ships next. 
 
 02. Turn spend into rooftops (Performance marketing) 
 Every dollar answers to an activated rooftop, not a click. Run paid across every channel dealers use: Google, Meta, LinkedIn, YouTube and AI-assistant ads, with CAC and payback tracked per agent. Prove what works with incrementality tests, not last-click attribution. Own the creative loop: brief, produce, test, kill and scale, using agentic workflows to ship hundreds of variants a month with a human eye on quality. Feed winners everywhere: what works in paid shapes the website, lifecycle and organic content. 
 
 03. Make the website and search sell for us (Web, SEO and AEO) 
 When a dealer searches or asks an AI assistant, Spyne shows up and converts. Run spyne.ai as a growth product: landing pages for every agent, role, DMS and OEM, with conversion tests always live. Scale programmatic SEO and AEO with the content team, and earn citations in AI answers. Build integration and comparison pages that convert dealers who are evaluating options. 
 
 04. Turn product usage into pipeline (Lifecycle and PLG to sales) 
 The rooftop that tries 1 agent becomes the dealer group that runs 6. Build lifecycle across email, SMS and in-product that moves rooftops from signup to activation to expansion. Define product-qualified leads with Sales and route them in minutes, not days. Spot dealer-group signals in usage and hand them to the revenue team with full context. Run referral loops that turn happy dealers into the next 10 signups. 
 
 05. Build the machine with AI (Growth ops and automation) 
 Automate the work before anyone hires for it. Own enrichment, scoring, routing and follow-up on clean CRM data. Build attribution from first touch to paid rooftop so marketing and sales trust the same numbers. Ship agentic workflows with tools such as Claude, Clay and n8n for research, personalization, content and reporting. Put Vini on our own inbound so every dealer lead gets an instant answer. 
 
 06. Launch every agent and every market (Launches and international) 
 Each new agent and each new country gets a launch that hits its number. Run growth for each new agent once Product hands it over after its first customers are live. Take winning US playbooks abroad and localize them so they feel native in each market. 
 
 How Well Measure You 
 Self-serve signups Activation rate Free-to-paid conversion CAC and payback by channel PQL-to-opportunity conversion Agents per rooftop 
 
 Your First 90 Days 
 Weeks 1 to 2: use every agent yourself, listen to Vini calls and sit in on dealer onboarding. Day 30: full funnel instrumented, baseline published, top 3 leaks named. Day 60: paid and lifecycle live for 2 agents with CAC tracked. Day 90: 30+ experiments shipped and a 2-quarter growth plan. 
 
 Who You Are 
 4 to 7 years in growth marketing at a product-led SaaS or AI company, with a funnel and a paid budget you owned. You can show the numbers: cohorts, CAC, payback and conversion, before and after your work. You write SQL or get close, and you build your own dashboards. You have creative taste and can explain why an ad wins. You already build with AI and have shipped at least 1 workflow that runs without you. You ship fast and close the loop. Every test gets a decision.

title: AI Enablement
description:
1. Role Details Role AI Learning & Enablement Specialist (AI Trainer Corporate Enablement) Company INFOTEK Solutions Experience 4–7 years Salary Range Location Gurugram — 91springboard, Sector 21B or 9B, Cyber City Work Model Full-time, on-site - 6 days a week (Monday to Saturday) Reports To Head of Technology & Delivery Role Scope Individual contributor at the outset, with scope to build and lead a small team as the function scales. Coverage is the Gurugram operation. Onboarding Entity INFOTEK Solutions Notice Period Immediate to 30 days 2. Job Description INFOTEK Solutions is an IT and digital solutions organisation. Our delivery spans software and web development, digital marketing and content, design, functional consulting and process automation, and we manage websites and the full social media presence of the accounts in our care across LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X, YouTube and Pinterest. A large volume of that work — content production, reporting, documentation, screening and MIS — is repetitive and currently manual. You will own the company-wide shift to AI-assisted working. That means auditing where every team loses hours, designing and delivering the training that closes the gap, building the prompt libraries and AI workflows teams use daily, setting the data-safety rules, and proving adoption with hard numbers reported to leadership every month. This is a hands-on builder-trainer role. You must be able to sit with a content writer, a designer, a recruiter or an accounts executive, watch them work for twenty minutes, and hand them a working AI workflow before you leave the desk. You will work in direct partnership with the Intelligent Automation Developer — you prove workflows manually with users, they convert the proven ones into fully automated pipelines. 3. Roles and Responsibilities AI Opportunity Assessment Audit every function — Technology & Delivery, Digital Marketing, Design, Functional Consulting, HR, Finance and Operations — and document current manual workflows with time-per-task measurements. Maintain a scored use-case backlog (effort vs. impact vs. risk) and a rolling quarterly AI roadmap with department-level hour-saving targets. Hand high-volume, rules-clear cases to the Intelligent Automation Developer for full automation. Training Design and Delivery Design and own a four-tier curriculum: AI Foundations (how LLMs work, hallucination checking, verification discipline) to AI at Work (role-specific prompting, document and data workflows) to AI Power User (chaining, projects, tool integration) to AI Champion (peer-trainer certification). Deliver instructor-led workshops, hands-on labs, desk-side 1:1 coaching and floor-walk clinics. Run a separate leadership track for department heads and HODs: where AI fits their function, what to expect from their teams, how to review AI-assisted work, and how to sponsor adoption rather than merely permit it. Hold a standing monthly working session with each function head to review what their team automated, what stalled and what to attempt next. Build and maintain prompt libraries, SOPs, quick-reference cards, video micro-lessons and an internal AI knowledge base. Role-Specific AI Playbooks Content & SEO: blog outlining and drafting from the keyword bank, consistent brand voice across every account we publish for, meta titles and descriptions, content briefs, blog repurposing into social posts. Social Media: caption and hashtag generation per brand and platform, monthly calendar drafting, creative brief writing, comment and DM response drafting. Design: AI-assisted concept ideation, copy variants for creatives, image prompt writing and asset iteration. HR & Recruitment: JD drafting, resume screening and shortlisting summaries, interview question sets, candidate communication drafts. Delivery & Consulting: requirement documentation, BRD and SOW drafting, test-case generation, code documentation, project status summaries. Finance & Operations: MIS commentary, variance explanation, invoice and quotation drafting, vendor comparison summaries. Integration and Workflow Building Teach and demonstrate AI connected to the tools people already use — Microsoft 365 and Copilot, Excel, Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, Google Workspace, Google Analytics and Search Console, the applicant tracking system, and project and ticketing tools. Build low-code AI workflows live in sessions using Claude and ChatGPT projects, Copilot Studio, Power Automate, Zapier/Make and Google Apps Script. Maintain a shared library of working workflows with clear “when to use this” documentation so solutions get reused, not rebuilt. Partnership with the Intelligent Automation Developer Run joint discovery with the Intelligent Automation Developer: you surface the opportunity from the floor, they assess technical feasibility, and together you decide whether a case is solved by training people or by building an automation. Write the requirement for anything handed over for automation — current process, volume, exceptions, the approval step and the success measure — so the developer is not re-discovering the process from scratch. Validate every delivered automation with the users who will run it: confirm it works in real conditions, train them on it, and write the runbook entry in language they understand. Own the adoption of delivered automations, not just their delivery — an automation nobody uses counts as a failure against your targets, not the developer's. Governance and Policy Draft, publish and enforce the INFOTEK Solutions AI Acceptable Use Policy — data classification, what may never be pasted into public AI tools, client-confidentiality boundaries, mandatory human review points, and sign-off rules for anything client-facing or published. Deliver mandatory AI risk and data-privacy briefings; maintain completion records for audit and client compliance. Own AI tool licence management end to end: evaluation, allocation, onboarding, utilisation review, renewal and de-provisioning. Measurement and Reporting Maintain the AI adoption scorecard and publish a monthly impact dashboard to leadership with department-level breakdowns. Run the quarterly AI Champions programme — identify, certify and support power users in every department. Conduct 30- and 60-day post-training effectiveness reviews based on observed behaviour change, not feedback forms. 4. Required Skills 4–7 years in corporate L&D, enablement, technical training or digital transformation, with demonstrable daily hands-on AI use in real work. Strong practical command of at least two of Claude, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot and Gemini — including projects, custom instructions and document/data analysis. Genuine prompt engineering ability: structured framing, few-shot examples, output-format control, task decomposition and systematic verification. Instructional design fundamentals (ADDIE or equivalent) and practical 70-20-10 application. Proven end-to-end training programme ownership with adoption numbers you can show. Excellent facilitation — equally effective with a room of thirty and one sceptical person at a desk. Advanced Microsoft 365 including Excel; clear business writing for SOPs, policy and training content. Change-management capability — handling resistance, job-security anxiety and entrenched ways of working. Good to have: Power Automate / Copilot Studio / Power Apps exposure; LMS administration; basic Python or Google Apps Script; DPDP Act 2023 and ISO/IEC 42001 awareness; agency, IT services or BPO background; AI-900, MS-4004 or Google Cloud Generative AI certification.

 Products: HelixtaHR & EazeeSign
 Location: Mohan Cooperative Industrial Estate, New Delhi
 Work Mode: Work From Office (5 Days a Week)
 Experience: 12+ Years of Relevant Experience 
 1. Role Overview We are looking for a senior, commercially driven Business Head SaaS Growth & Revenue to take end-to-end ownership of business growth, customer acquisition, sales performance, and revenue generation for HelixtaHR and EazeeSign. The role requires a proven B2B SaaS or technology business leader with direct accountability for revenue, business growth, or P&L targets and demonstrated experience leading both Marketing/Growth and Sales/BDM functions. The individual will be responsible for translating Management’s business vision into an executable go-to-market strategy, identifying commercial gaps independently, aligning cross-functional teams, improving conversion at every stage of the sales funnel, and delivering predictable, measurable, product-wise revenue growth. This is not a Digital Marketing, SEO, Sales Management, or departmental coordination role. We require a business leader who owns the complete commercial outcome, from product positioning and demand generation to customer acquisition, deal closures, revenue, and customer retention. 
 2. Products HelixtaHR: An AI-enabled Human Resource Management System offering HRMS, payroll, attendance, recruitment, and AI-assisted HR capabilities. EazeeSign: An AI-enabled electronic signature platform designed to streamline digital signing and document workflows, with capabilities such as document summaries, clause extraction, and risk analysis. The Business Head will establish and execute separate growth strategies for both products, considering their target markets, customer segments, positioning, pricing, sales cycles, and revenue potential. 
 3. Key Objective To establish a commercially accountable, data-driven growth function that consistently converts marketing investments and sales activities into qualified opportunities, paying customers, and sustainable revenue. Success will be measured by actual business outcomes rather than marketing activities, traffic, lead volumes, meetings, or team size alone. 
 4. Key Responsibilities A. Business Strategy & Revenue Ownership Develop and execute product-wise business growth strategies for HelixtaHR and EazeeSign. Establish annual, quarterly, and monthly revenue targets in alignment with Management. Translate business objectives into actionable go-to-market plans, commercial priorities, budgets, and execution roadmaps. Identify target industries, customer segments, buyer personas, geographic markets, and ideal customer profiles. Own qualified pipeline development, opportunity progression, closures, revenue forecasting, and revenue achievement. Identify new business opportunities, strategic partnerships, expansion opportunities, and additional revenue streams. Develop a repeatable and scalable commercial growth model for both products. B. Marketing, Growth & Demand Generation Lead the commercial direction and alignment of Digital Marketing, SEO, content, website, landing pages, videos, social media, and demand-generation campaigns. Ensure that marketing strategies support product positioning, target customer acquisition, qualified pipeline creation, and revenue goals. Review website messaging, product value propositions, AI capabilities, calls to action, landing-page journeys, and conversion performance. Identify gaps in organic search, paid campaigns, content strategy, audience targeting, lead quality, and campaign effectiveness. Ensure SEO and marketing activities generate relevant business opportunities rather than traffic and activity metrics alone. Establish campaign-wise and channel-wise performance measurement, attribution, budget allocation, and return-on-investment tracking. Work with functional leaders to initiate corrective actions and continuously improve commercial performance. C. Sales & BDM Leadership Lead the commercial direction, targets, processes, and performance management of the BDM/Sales function. Establish clear sales stages, qualification criteria, lead-response timelines, follow-up standards, and opportunity ownership. Improve demo-to-proposal and proposal-to-closure conversion rates. Participate in strategic client discussions, key product demonstrations, negotiations, and high-value deal closures. Review sales performance, opportunity ageing, stalled deals, customer objections, and lost opportunities. Develop effective sales playbooks, objection-handling frameworks, proposal standards, and follow-up processes. Establish accountability for individual sales productivity, revenue contribution, and target achievement. D. Product Positioning, Pricing & Competitive Strategy Define and refine the commercial positioning, value proposition, messaging, and differentiation of HelixtaHR and EazeeSign. Evaluate pricing, packaging, subscription models, commercial proposals, and discounting strategies. Conduct competitor analysis and identify opportunities to strengthen market positioning. Ensure product capabilities, including AI-related features, are communicated accurately and effectively to target buyers. Work with Management and relevant product stakeholders to align customer needs, market opportunities, and commercial priorities. Analyse customer feedback, objections, reasons for rejection, and market expectations to recommend improvements. E. Website, SEO & Conversion Optimisation Evaluate website and landing-page effectiveness from a commercial and customer-conversion perspective. Ensure product messaging, customer benefits, use cases, trust signals, and calls to action are aligned with target audiences. Collaborate with website, SEO, content, and design teams to improve user journeys and conversion rates. Review lead sources, conversion data, traffic quality, engagement, and customer acquisition performance. Identify and prioritise improvements based on their expected commercial impact. Ensure that SEO and website initiatives contribute to qualified pipeline and measurable business growth. F. CRM, Pipeline Management & Revenue Forecasting Establish CRM discipline, accurate opportunity records, sales-stage definitions, and mandatory next actions. Ensure every qualified opportunity has an owner, estimated deal value, next action, and expected closure date. Maintain separate pipeline visibility for HelixtaHR and EazeeSign. Build reliable revenue forecasts based on pipeline quality, conversion history, sales-cycle duration, and deal probability. Track lead-to-opportunity, opportunity-to-demo, demo-to-proposal, and proposal-to-closure conversion. Review lost opportunities, pipeline leakage, delayed follow-ups, and forecast accuracy. Present data-backed business reviews with corrective actions, responsible owners, and target dates. G. Commercial Leadership & Cross-Functional Accountability Establish commercial priorities across Digital Marketing, SEO, website development, content, videos, social media, campaigns, and BDM/Sales. Independently identify gaps, challenge underperforming strategies, and recommend corrective measures. Work with existing department heads, who will continue to manage their respective functional teams and day-to-day execution. Ensure cross-functional activities remain aligned with agreed commercial targets and priorities. Define expected outcomes, responsibilities, timelines, and measurable success criteria for key initiatives. Escalate resource constraints, investment requirements, and strategic decisions to Management with clear recommendations. Build a culture of accountability, analytical decision-making, continuous improvement, and revenue ownership. H. Customer Acquisition, Retention & Business Economics Monitor customer acquisition cost (CAC), marketing return on investment, sales efficiency, and cost of customer acquisition. Evaluate customer quality, revenue potential, retention, renewals, and expansion opportunities where applicable. Work with relevant teams to identify churn risks, customer feedback patterns, and opportunities to improve customer lifetime value. Recommend commercially viable growth initiatives based on customer economics and business priorities. 
 5. Required Qualifications & Experience Minimum 12+ years of relevant experience in B2B SaaS, software products, or technology-led businesses. title: Business Development Executive B2B & D2C(Sales Marketing & IT Service)
description:
Job Description: Business Development Executive (B2B Sales, Digital Marketing & IT Services) 
 Job Title: Business Development Executive (BDE)
 Department: Sales & Business Development
 Industry: Digital Marketing / IT Services / D2C
 Experience: 1-3 years
 Employment Type: Full-time
 Work Location: Vaishali Sec-1 
 Salary: 25k to 40k in-hand (Other incentives) 
 About the Role We are looking for a proactive, target-driven Business Development Executive to drive business growth through B2B lead generation, client acquisition, and relationship management. The ideal candidate should have experience in selling digital marketing services, website development, or IT solutions, with strong communication, negotiation, and closing skills. 
 The candidate will be responsible for identifying potential clients, understanding their business requirements, presenting tailored service solutions, and converting prospects into long-term customers. Experience working with digital marketing agencies, D2C brands, e-commerce businesses, or IT service providers will be an added advantage. 
 Key Responsibilities 1. Lead Generation & Prospecting Identify and research potential B2B clients, including D2C brands, e-commerce businesses, startups, SMEs, and growing enterprises. Generate qualified leads through cold calling, email outreach, LinkedIn, online research, and other prospecting channels. Build and maintain a strong pipeline of potential clients and identify new business opportunities. Connect with founders, business owners, marketing heads, and other key decision-makers. 
 2. Sales & Client Acquisition Conduct discovery calls and client meetings to understand business goals, challenges, and marketing requirements. Pitch relevant services, including performance marketing, paid advertising, social media marketing, website development, and conversion rate optimization (CRO). Prepare customized proposals, presentations, quotations, and commercial offers based on client requirements. Manage the complete sales cycle, from initial outreach and follow-ups to negotiation and deal closure. Achieve assigned sales targets, revenue goals, and client acquisition objectives. 
 3. Pipeline & CRM Management Maintain accurate records of leads, client interactions, follow-ups, proposals, and sales opportunities. Regularly update the sales pipeline and CRM to track deal progress and conversion rates. Ensure timely follow-ups with prospects to improve conversion and minimize lead drop-offs. Monitor sales performance and provide regular updates on pipeline status and business opportunities. 
 4. Client Relationship Management Build strong, long-term relationships with clients to encourage repeat business, renewals, and referrals. Coordinate with internal teams, including marketing, creative, and technical teams, to ensure smooth onboarding and service delivery. Identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling additional services. Gather client feedback and support ongoing account growth and customer satisfaction. 
 5. Market Research & Business Growth Research market trends, competitor offerings, and potential customer segments. Identify opportunities to expand the client base and improve sales performance. Share market insights and client feedback with internal teams to improve service offerings and sales strategies. 
 Required Skills & Qualifications 13 years of experience in B2B sales, business development, client acquisition, or service-based sales. Experience in a digital marketing agency, IT services company, website development company, or related industry is preferred. Strong understanding of B2B lead generation, sales prospecting, client pitching, and deal closure. Excellent verbal and written communication, presentation, and negotiation skills. Ability to understand client requirements and recommend suitable service solutions. Experience in preparing proposals, quotations, and sales presentations. Proficiency in managing sales pipelines, maintaining client records, and conducting consistent follow-ups. Familiarity with CRM tools, LinkedIn prospecting, email outreach, and cold calling. A target-oriented mindset with the ability to work independently and manage multiple prospects. Graduate in any discipline; a background in business, marketing, or management is preferred. 
 Preferred Experience Candidates with experience in any of the following will be given preference: Selling performance marketing and paid advertising services. Selling social media management and digital marketing packages. Selling website development, e-commerce website solutions, or IT services. Working with D2C brands, e-commerce businesses, startups, and SMEs. Managing end-to-end B2B sales cycles and achieving revenue targets. Generating business through outbound sales, LinkedIn outreach, and cold calling. 
 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) 
 Performance will be evaluated based on: Number of qualified leads generated. Discovery calls and client meetings conducted. Proposals shared and follow-ups completed. Lead-to-client conversion rate. New clients acquired and revenue generated. Achievement of monthly and quarterly sales targets. Client retention, repeat business, and upselling opportunities. 
 Ideal Candidate Profile We are looking for someone who is confident in approaching new clients, comfortable with outbound sales, skilled at presenting service offerings, and capable of converting business opportunities into revenue. The ideal candidate should demonstrate ownership of the sales process, consistent follow-up discipline, and a genuine interest in helping businesses grow through digital solutions. 
 If you are passionate about B2B sales, enjoy building client relationships, and want to contribute directly to business growth, we would appreciate hearing from you. 
 Interested candidates can share their resume at the email address below: info.berservices@gmail.com 
 Regards, HR Department BER SERVICES PVT LTD

You will connect with the CEETRIS/ global teams to pull brand solutions from the network and help develop via work packages where gaps exist. You will be a member of the Cross Functional Pan India Disease Squad; and report into the Disease Area squad Lead.

They are closest to our customers and their insights need to lead the strategy development. You will be building strong relationships with the identified key stakeholders from Key Doctors, Accounts or Government stakeholders to build Roche equity and gain customer insights - to incorporate into our work. You will ensure compliance of the marketing strategy with Roche and Local guidelines for all Roche Initiatives and develop Patient Persona based solutions. You will liaison with Global & regional team for brand related campaigns, cross Pollination of Best Practices and share insights from cluster specific data on patients, diseases, patient journey etc and design solutions to increase patient impact Design of awareness campaigns solving for patient journey challenges & calculate ROIs and support customization of pricing. In this context, the role provides commercial insights to inform Access & Medical functions, but does not own decision-making for pricing, commercial contracting, reimbursement, etc. Marketing and field insights will be generated using methodologies that comply with data privacy laws, competition laws, and ethical standards. This individual will possess a powerful combination of commercial acumen, strong alliance management capabilities, and a proven track record of high-impact marketing execution within the complex Indian healthcare ecosystem. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

title: Manager - Digital Fundraising
description:
Job DESCRIPTION Job Title: Manager - Digital Fundraising Grade: F Department: Resource Mobilization Reporting to: Director - RM Location: National Support Office (NSO), New Delhi Contract duration: 5 years (extendable) About Bal Raksha Bharat Bal Raksha Bharat (also known as Save the Children) is Indias leading independent child rights organisation. It is a member of Save the Children movement that operates globally with the mission to inspire breakthroughs in the way the world treats children and achieve immediate and lasting changes in their lives. We are working towards three breakthroughs in how the world treats children by 2030: - No child dies from preventable causes before their fifth birthday - All children learn from a quality basic education - Violence against children is no longer tolerated We implement programmes in the remotest corners of India and urban areas in the areas of Health & Nutrition, Education, Child Protection and Livelihood & Economic Wellbeing in order to facilitate quality education, healthcare and protection from harm and abuse and life-saving aid during emergencies to children. Role Purpose : Digital lead is in charge of planning and managing marketing campaigns that promote organisations work, bring in donations and improve its presence and brand value. Their duties include planning campaigns, analysing metrics, and identifying trends. Roles & Responsibilities Design, execution and overseeing of a long term competent and innovating national digital engagement and fundraising strategy, as well as an annual action plan for the online fundraising activities, ensuring that they are aligned with Save the Children India objectives and programmes. Design, execution and overseeing of the digital fundraising emergency plan. Experience to lead, design, implement and monitor the digital campaign with all digital social and marketing channel Overseeing of the web fundraising content and functionalities as well as the implementation of digital marketing and fundraising campaign initiatives. Design and implement online acquisition campaign using paid search and online advertising. Manage relationships with external vendors and agencies. Design and implement other digital fundraising campaigns like crowdfunding / community fundraising, mobile apps, etc. Assist the Donor Development department to design, implement and optimize the digital donor life cycle. Editing and setting up email campaigns when needed. Collaborate with other fundraising departments to ensure proper digital support and web content to maximize overall fundraising success. Network with Save the Children International to share ideas and leverage best practice from other offices. Other duties as requested by the Head of Fundraising. BEHAVIOURS (Values in Practice) Accountability - Holds self and others accountable for delivering high-quality, timely and compliant services aligned with organisational goals. - Demonstrates ownership and responsibility for procurement decisions, resources and commitments with integrity. Ambition - Sets ambitious goals for efficiency, value for money, service quality and operational excellence. - Seeks opportunities to simplify, innovate and build a high-performing procurement and facilities function. Collaboration - Builds strong relationships across functions, state teams and external stakeholders. - Encourages mutual respect, transparency, knowledge sharing and customer-focused service. Creativity - Brings innovative and practical solutions to sourcing, facilities, technology and cost optimisation challenges. - Champions new approaches that improve efficiency, sustainability and user experience. Integrity - Upholds the highest ethical standards, transparency and fairness in procurement and vendor dealings. - Promotes responsible stewardship of organisational resources and puts childrens best interests at the centre of decisions. QUALIFICATIONS MBA/ PGDBM from a reputed Institute / Masters in English or Journalism or Mass Communications EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS Minimum 7 years of experience in digital fundraising or e-commerce designing including management of digital operations for at least 3 years. Relevant experience developing digital engagement and awareness campaigns with a proven record of accomplishments. Experience to manage digital fundraising agencies. Skills & Knowledge Deep knowledge of search and display Campaigns, paid social media advertising, digital marketing and lead generation and conversion programs. Working knowledge of web development and web analytics. Proven ability to do result driven data analysis. Positive and learned professional with team management experience and exceptional ability to organize and manage multiple priorities. Strong written and verbal English communication skills, Solid knowledge of MS office applications. Self-motivated, mentally strong leader with an ability to inspire team members and keep the team together. Equal Opportunities Bal Raksha Bharat aims to be an equal opportunity employer. We welcome all applications irrespective of age, race, colour, gender, disability, sexual orientation, religion, belief or creed. Women candidates are encouraged to apply. Child Safeguarding We need to keep children safe so our selection process, which includes rigorous background checks, reflects our commitment to the protection of children from abuse. CHILD SAFEGUARDING (Strike out whichever is not applicable) Level 1: The role holder will not have contact with children and/or young people, or access to personal data about children or young people, as part of their work; therefore, a police check will not be mandatory unless the content or location of the role changes, in which case the Child Safeguarding level will be reviewed. Level 2: Either the role holder will have access to personal data about children and/or young people as part of their work; or they will be working in a regulated position (Finance, Monitoring & Evaluation, Legal etc.); therefore, a police check will be required. Level 3: The role holder will have contact with children and/or young people either frequently (e.g. once a week or more) or intensively (e.g. four days in one month or more or overnight) because they work in programs; or are visiting programs; therefore a police check will be required. Recommended for this role: Level 2, subject to BRBs role-based safeguarding assessment. Safeguarding our Staff The post holder is required to carry out the duties in accordance with the BRB s anti-harassment policy and all applicable safeguarding, health, safety, security and ethical standards.

title: Performance Marketing Specialist
description:
We are hiring a Performance Marketing Specialist to plan, run and scale our paid acquisition across Meta and Google. You will own budget allocation, campaign structure, creative testing and channel efficiency for every programme vertical. The role is accountable for how much we spend, where it goes, and what it returns in qualified leads and admissions. 
 Why this role Paid media is measured by the qualified leads and admissions it returns, not by spend or clicks alone. Cost per lead is not the finish line; paid performance is judged on what happens beyond the click. Creative and budget decisions should be driven by performance data rather than opinion. Spend that is not returning admissions should be paused or rebuilt, not left to run. You will work closely with the Creative, Funnel and CRM teams to improve landing page performance, lead quality and paid channel efficiency. 
 What you will do You will own paid acquisition across Meta and Google, from budget planning and campaign build to optimisation and reporting. Plan, launch and manage paid campaigns across Meta and Google Ads for each programme vertical. Own monthly budget allocation across channels, campaigns and programmes, and manage pacing against plan. Build and maintain campaign architecture, naming conventions, audiences, placements and bid strategies. Run a continuous creative testing pipeline and brief the creative team based on performance data rather than opinion. Manage search keyword strategy, run search-term audits and maintain negative keyword lists. Monitor delivery daily and act on rising costs, frequency and creative fatigue before they compound. Maintain accurate conversion tracking and attribution across platforms and landing pages. Analyse performance by programme, geography, audience and creative, and reallocate budget to what converts. Pause or rebuild campaigns that are not returning admissions and document the reasons. Work with the Funnel and CRM team on landing page performance and lead quality feedback loops. Report weekly on spend, cost per lead, cost per admission and channel-level efficiency. 
 What you will deliver Key Result Areas (KRAs) Paid media planning and budget management Campaign performance and cost efficiency Creative testing and audience development Tracking, attribution and reporting accuracy Programme-level admissions growth through paid channels 
 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Cost per lead and cost per admission against target Monthly spend pacing against plan, including underspend and overspend variance Return on ad spend, measured against the agreed ticket value CTR, CPC and CPM trends by channel, quarter on quarter Lead-to-admission conversion rate of paid leads Number of creatives tested per month and share of spend behind winning creatives Share of spend on campaigns with zero attributed admissions, to be minimised Turnaround time from identifying an underperforming campaign to acting on it 
 Who we are looking for Must have Bachelor's degree with 24 years of hands-on experience managing paid media budgets across Meta and Google Ads. Demonstrable ownership of a monthly media budget. Strong grasp of campaign structure, audience building, bid strategies and search-term management. Practical tracking knowledge, including UTM discipline, pixel and conversion event setup, and tag management. Comfortable working in spreadsheets and able to build performance reports independently. Ability to read a funnel beyond the click, with the understanding that cost per lead is not the finish line. Target-driven, with the discipline to pause spend that is not working. 
 Good to have Experience in education, edtech or other high-consideration categories. 
 How you work Data-led. You brief creative and move budget based on performance data, not opinion. Funnel-minded. You look beyond the click and judge campaigns by the admissions they return. Disciplined. You pause spend that is not working and document why. Vigilant. You monitor delivery daily and act on rising costs and creative fatigue before they compound. Accurate. You keep tracking, attribution and reporting clean across platforms and landing pages. Target-driven. You work to clear cost, pacing and admissions targets. Owner. You take responsibility for the monthly budget, from plan to pacing to return. 
 What you get Ownership of a monthly media budget across Meta and Google, not just the execution of campaigns. The opportunity to run paid acquisition for every programme vertical. Direct accountability for programme-level admissions growth through paid channels. The opportunity to work closely with the Creative, Funnel and CRM teams on landing pages and lead quality. Visible work, with results measured in qualified leads and admissions. 
 About MedhaviOne MedhaviOne is building India's education-to-employment infrastructure: shared standards for skills and credentials that connect institutions, employers and learners. The Medhavi Group already has: 600+ enterprise partners across 30+ sectors, including Hyundai, Mahindra, MRF, Daikin, IHG Hotels and the Indian Navy; 650,000+ learners reached across India Its own skills university, Medhavi Skills University, with close to 2,000 students on campus The base is built. We now need people to build the next businesses on top of it. For more information, visit https://www.medhavione.com/

title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
Job Description Digital Marketing Manager Organization: Asia-Pacific Institute of Management (AIM)
 Location: Jasola, New Delhi
 Department: Marketing & Admissions
 Position: Digital Marketing Manager
 Employment Type: Full-Time | On-Site
 Experience Required: 4–7 Years (preferably in Education / EdTech / Lead Generation) About AIM Asia-Pacific Institute of Management (AIM) is a leading management education institution in New Delhi with a legacy of nearly three decades. The institute offers industry-oriented management programs, including PGDM, MBA in Healthcare Management, and undergraduate programs. We are looking for a highly analytical, technically proficient, and results-driven Digital Marketing Manager to oversee our digital marketing operations, manage external agencies, and ensure measurable growth in student applications and admissions. Key Responsibilities 1. Performance Marketing & Agency Management Act as the primary point of contact for all digital marketing and performance marketing agencies. Oversee campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, YouTube, and other relevant digital platforms. Monitor campaign budgets, lead generation, lead quality, cost per lead (CPL), cost per application (CPA), and overall return on marketing investment. Independently review campaign structures, audience targeting, bidding strategies, keyword performance, and conversion tracking. Conduct regular performance reviews with agencies and ensure timely execution of agreed deliverables. Identify underperforming campaigns and recommend corrective actions. Ensure that agencies continuously optimize campaigns rather than simply manage advertising budgets. 2. Digital Marketing Tools & Technical Expertise The candidate should possess strong working knowledge of: Paid Advertising Google Ads (Search, Display, Performance Max, YouTube, Remarketing) Meta Ads Manager (Facebook & Instagram) LinkedIn Ads and other relevant advertising platforms Analytics & Tracking Google Analytics 4 (GA4) Google Tag Manager (GTM) Google Search Console Looker Studio Meta Pixel and Conversions API UTM tracking, conversion events, attribution, and remarketing audiences SEO & Website Optimization On-page, off-page, and technical SEO fundamentals Keyword research using tools such as SEMrush, Ahrefs, and Google Keyword Planner Landing page optimization, A/B testing, and conversion rate optimization (CRO) Website performance monitoring and user journey analysis CRM & Marketing Automation LeadSquared or similar CRM platforms Lead source attribution and campaign-to-CRM integration WhatsApp, email, and SMS marketing automation Lead nurturing workflows and remarketing campaigns 3. Lead Generation & Admissions Funnel Management Take ownership of digital lead generation performance across AIM's academic programs. Track the complete admissions funnel: Impressions Clicks Leads Qualified Leads Applications Admissions. Work closely with the admissions team to evaluate lead quality and conversion performance. Identify lead leakage, attribution errors, duplicate leads, and ineffective lead sources. Ensure accurate lead capture, campaign tagging, and CRM integration. Recommend strategies to improve lead-to-application and application-to-admission conversion rates. Monitor program-wise performance and allocate marketing resources accordingly. 4. Reporting, Analytics & Budget Monitoring Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly digital marketing performance reports. Develop dashboards to monitor campaign performance, expenditure, and admissions conversions. Track and analyze key metrics, including:
 Cost per Lead (CPL) Cost per Qualified Lead (CPQL) Cost per Application (CPA) Cost per Admission / Acquisition (CAC) Click-Through Rate (CTR) Conversion Rate (CVR) Return on Ad Spend (ROAS), where measurable Verify agency-reported data against advertising platforms, analytics tools, and CRM records. Monitor budget utilization and ensure campaigns remain within approved spending limits. Present actionable recommendations to management based on performance data. 5. SEO, Content & Digital Brand Visibility Oversee SEO agencies and ensure improvements in organic search visibility and relevant keyword rankings. Coordinate with content and creative teams to ensure campaign messaging aligns with AIM's positioning. Review advertising copies, creatives, landing pages, and promotional content for accuracy and effectiveness. Monitor website traffic, organic leads, and search performance. Ensure consistent messaging across all digital channels. 6. Campaign Planning & Execution Work with management and agencies to develop program-wise digital marketing strategies. Coordinate campaign launches for admissions cycles, webinars, events, and institutional initiatives. Ensure timely delivery of creatives, landing pages, campaign assets, and tracking integrations. Research competitors, market trends, student search behavior, and emerging digital marketing opportunities. Support new initiatives involving marketing automation, AI-driven campaign optimization, and digital outreach. Required Skills & Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field. 4–7 years of relevant digital marketing experience, preferably involving performance marketing and lead generation. Strong hands-on understanding of Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, GA4, GTM, and digital analytics. Demonstrated experience managing or supervising significant advertising budgets. Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets and marketing dashboards. Experience working with marketing agencies and independently evaluating their performance. Understanding of CRM systems, marketing automation, and lead management processes. Strong analytical ability, attention to detail, and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication, coordination, and stakeholder management skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience in higher education, business schools, education marketing, or EdTech. Google Ads and Google Analytics certifications. Experience with LeadSquared CRM. Familiarity with AI-powered marketing tools, automation, and advanced reporting. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Performance will be evaluated based on: Quality and volume of leads generated across academic programs. Improvement in lead-to-application and application-to-admission conversion rates. Optimization of CPL, CPA, and cost per admission. Accuracy of campaign tracking, reporting, and CRM attribution. Agency accountability, execution quality, and timely delivery of campaigns. Improvement in organic search visibility and website conversion rates. Effective utilization of digital marketing budgets. Ideal Candidate Profile We are looking for someone who understands digital marketing beyond dashboards and reports. The ideal candidate should be capable of logging into Google Ads or Meta Ads Manager, independently understanding campaign performance, identifying problems, questioning agency strategies, and recommending improvements. This is not merely an agency coordination role. The candidate must have strong technical knowledge, commercial awareness, and the ability to translate digital marketing expenditure into measurable student applications and admissions. The role requires someone who can take ownership, work independently, and ensure AIM's digital marketing agencies deliver results aligned with the institute's admissions objectives.

title: Marketing Assistant - Gurgaon
description:
Marketing Specialist - Electrophysiology Role Overview The Marketing Specialist will coordinate and execute day-to-day marketing activities for the Electrophysiology business, translating marketing plans into timely, compliant, and high-quality deliverables. The role will own campaign and content coordination, educational-program execution, agency and vendor management, marketing operations, budget tracking, data reporting, and documentation across offline and digital channels. Working closely with Marketing, Sales, Clinical, Medical Affairs, Regulatory, Legal, Finance, Procurement, and external partners, the candidate will maintain execution discipline, brand consistency, stakeholder alignment, and closure of agreed actions. Key Responsibilities Marketing Planning, Operations & Coordination - Coordinate the day-to-day execution of approved marketing plans, campaigns, product launches, educational initiatives, and internal communications. - Build and maintain annual and monthly marketing calendars, campaign workbacks, activity trackers, risk logs, and project timelines. - Serve as the coordination point for Marketing, Sales, Clinical, Medical Affairs, Regulatory, Legal, Finance, Procurement, agencies, and vendors. - Track dependencies, escalate execution risks early, and drive agreed actions to closure within approved timelines and budgets. - Manage marketing requests, briefs, approval status, asset versions, distribution readiness, and activity closure documentation. - Identify process gaps and recommend practical improvements to increase execution speed, visibility, and accountability. Campaigns, Product Launches & Market Development - Coordinate with vendors for timely follow-ups and revisions based on the briefs provided to them. - Coordinate campaign assets and activation across email, digital,field communication, conferences, workshops, and physician-education programs. - Support new-product introductions through launch trackers, asset readiness, internal communication, field enablement materials, and post-launch performance updates. - Collate market, customer, competitor, event, and channel inputs and convert them into structured summaries and actionable marketing recommendations. - Conduct post-activity reviews, document lessons learned, and recommend improvements for future campaigns and programs. Content, Brand & Promotional Compliance - Proofread, and coordinate for invitations, flyers, presentations, social-media content, internal communications, videos, and field-facing materials. - Maintain a controlled library of approved assets, source files, claims, references, image permissions, expiry dates, and version history. - Ensure materials follow approved brand standards, intended-use requirements, review workflows, and applicable healthcare-compliance processes before release. Educational Programs, Events & Stakeholder Engagement - Coordinate for CMEs, webinars, workshops, roadshows, congress activities, physician programs, and internal marketing meetings from planning through closure. - Maintain agendas, invitations, registrations, participant lists, faculty requirements, venue and vendor coordination, materials, and run-of-show documents. - Track approvals, documentation, attendance, feedback, photographs, expenses, and post-event reports for timely and complete closure. - Maintain a forward calendar of conferences, scientific programs, launch milestones, and key customer-engagement opportunities. Data, Insights & Performance Reporting - Maintain accurate marketing databases, customer and stakeholder lists, event records, campaign data, activity trackers, and documentation repositories. - Prepare monthly and quarterly dashboards covering activity status, campaign performance, event outcomes, budget status, risks, and next actions. - Consolidate quantitative and qualitative feedback and highlight trends, gaps, and opportunities for marketing decision-making. - Ensure data quality, confidentiality, appropriate access, and timely correction of inaccurate or incomplete records. Budget, Vendor & Marketing Administration Track approved marketing budgets, purchase orders, invoices, commitments, accrual inputs, and spend against plan. Coordinate vendor onboarding, estimates, scopes, timelines, deliverable acceptance, and payment documentation. Maintain inventory and dispatch records for approved marketing materials and flag replenishment or obsolescence risks. Prepare meeting agendas, minutes, action trackers, and concise status updates for routine marketing governance. Electrophysiology Knowledge The candidate will develop a BASIC working understanding of the Electrophysiology market, customer pathway, and core therapies and technologies, including atrial fibrillation, ablation, pulsed field ablation, and 3D mapping. Prior technical knowledge is advantageous but not mandatory; curiosity, learning agility, and the ability to communicate accurately in a regulated healthcare category are essential. Key Skills & Competencies Strong project coordination, prioritization, organization, and follow-through across multiple workstreams. Clear written and verbal communication with strong proofreading, documentation, and presentation skills. Working proficiency in PowerPoint, Excel, and Word; familiarity with Canva, marketing automation, analytics, CRM, or content-management tools is advantageous. Basic understanding of campaign execution, digital channels, social media, event marketing, and performance metrics. High attention to detail, data accuracy, brand consistency, confidentiality, and compliance discipline. Ability to work independently, solve routine execution issues, manage agencies and vendors, and escalate risks appropriately. Proactive, dependable, adaptable, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment. Preferred Qualifications - Bachelor s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, Life Sciences, or a related field. - 1-3 years of experience in marketing coordination, campaign execution, digital marketing, events, healthcare, medical devices, pharmaceuticals, or a comparable regulated industry. - Demonstrated experience managing timelines, stakeholders, content assets, reporting, or vendor deliverables is preferred. - Experience with digital platforms, design tools, CRM, analytics, marketing automation, or event-management systems would be an advantage. Measures of Success On-time delivery of campaigns, events, assets, reports, and assigned actions. Accuracy and completeness of trackers, databases, budgets, approvals, and closure documentation. Campaign and program performance against agreed reach, engagement, attendance, or adoption indicators. Stakeholder responsiveness, agency and vendor discipline, brand consistency, and compliance readiness. Quality of insights, risk escalation, process improvements, and execution recommendations.

title: Digital Marketing Assistant
description:
Digital Marketing Account Manager Performance Marketing & Social Media Company: SK Consulting Marketing
 Location: Central Delhi
 Work Mode: In-Office
 Employment Type: Full-Time 
 About SK Consulting Marketing 
 SK Consulting Marketing is a strategic digital marketing agency helping Luxury, Lifestyle, Healthcare, EdTech and Personal Brands drive measurable business growth through the combination of experienced marketing professionals and AI-powered marketing systems. We work across Brand Marketing, Content Marketing, Social Media, Performance Marketing, SEO, CRM, Funnels and AI-led marketing operations. We are looking for a Digital Marketing Account Manager who can independently manage the day-to-day digital marketing operations of multiple clients and take ownership of performance, execution and client communication. 
 The Role This is not a pure social media or client servicing role. The ideal candidate should be equally comfortable with: Managing client accounts Planning and executing digital marketing strategies Running and optimizing Meta Ads & Google Ads Managing social media operations Analysing campaign performance Communicating with clients Coordinating with creative/content teams Using AI to improve everyday marketing operations Identifying opportunities to improve client results and agency processes 
 You will be expected to think, execute, analyse and proactively solve problems rather than simply follow instructions. 
 Key Responsibilities 1. Performance Marketing Plan, launch, manage and optimize Meta Ads and Google Ads campaigns. Manage campaigns across Lead Generation, Sales, Traffic, Remarketing and Conversion objectives. Conduct audience, keyword, competitor and campaign research. Monitor CPL, CPA, ROAS, CTR, CPC, CVR and other relevant performance metrics. Analyse campaign performance and identify opportunities for optimization. Manage campaign budgets and allocation across platforms. Develop hypotheses, test creatives/audiences/campaign structures and implement learnings. Understand conversion tracking, pixels, events and basic GA4/GTM concepts. Prepare performance reports with clear business insights and recommendations. 
 2. Social Media Operations Develop and execute social media strategies for multiple client accounts. Manage monthly content calendars and ensure timely execution. Coordinate with graphic designers, video editors, copywriters and other team members. Review content before client submission/publishing. Track content performance and recommend improvements. Stay updated with Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn and YouTube trends and platform developments. 
 3. Account Management Act as the primary point of contact for assigned clients. Conduct regular client calls and communicate campaign progress, challenges and opportunities. Understand client business objectives and translate them into marketing actions. Manage timelines, deliverables and internal teams. Proactively identify problems before they become client escalations. Build strong, professional client relationships. 
 4. AI & Marketing Innovation This is an important part of the role. We are looking for someone who is AI-friendly and curious about how AI can fundamentally improve the way a marketing agency operates. You should be comfortable using AI tools for: Campaign analysis Research Content ideation Copywriting Reporting Competitor analysis Client communication SOP creation Data analysis Workflow automation Marketing strategy Productivity and operational efficiency More importantly, you should be able to identify new ways of using AI to make the agency faster, smarter and more scalable. What We're Looking For 
 Mandatory 2-4 years of relevant digital marketing experience Strong hands-on experience with Meta Ads Strong hands-on experience with Google Ads Experience managing multiple client accounts Good understanding of social media marketing Strong analytical and problem-solving ability Excellent written and spoken English Strong client communication skills Ability to independently manage deadlines and priorities Comfortable working in a fast-paced agency environment Strong interest in AI and emerging marketing technologies 
 Preferred Prior experience in a digital marketing/advertising agency Experience with both lead-generation and e-commerce campaigns Google Analytics / GA4 Google Tag Manager Looker Studio CRM / marketing automation WhatsApp marketing SEO fundamentals Shopify / e-commerce ecosystem Experience using AI tools beyond basic content generation 
 The Kind of Person We Want 
 We are looking for someone who is: 
 Proactive Doesn't wait to be told every next step. Analytical Looks at numbers and understands what they mean for the business. Client-oriented – Can communicate confidently and professionally with business owners and senior stakeholders. AI-native – Uses AI to improve how they work rather than treating it as just a content-writing tool. Accountable – Takes ownership of outcomes, deadlines and client requirements. Curious – Constantly learns, experiments and brings new ideas to the table. Execution-focused – Can turn strategy into actual campaigns, content and measurable outcomes. 
 Why Join SK Consulting Marketing? Work directly with multiple Luxury, Lifestyle, Healthcare, EdTech and Personal Brands Opportunity to work across both strategy and execution Exposure to Meta Ads, Google Ads, social media, funnels, CRM and AI High ownership and autonomy Opportunity to build AI-powered marketing processes within a growing agency Work closely with the Founder/Strategic Head Hybrid working environment in Central Delhi Opportunity to grow into a senior account/strategy role 
 Candidates with exceptional hands-on expertise may be considered outside this range. How to Apply Please apply with: Updated CV Brief summary of your experience managing Meta Ads + Google Ads Examples of campaigns/accounts you have personally managed, wherever possible A short note describing how you currently use AI in your daily marketing workflow 
 Only candidates with strong hands-on experience in both Meta Ads and Google Ads will be considered.

description:
**About the Role**
  

  

The Social team is responsible for telling Uber's story in an engaging, inspiring, humanizing and innovative way across global channels, and to a global audience. We develop creative programming ourselves, build relationships with key influencers and creators, and launch new products and partnerships in a Social\-first way.
  

  

As the Head of Social Media Manager for India and Sri Lanka, you will play a crucial role in developing and executing strategic social plans to evolve and elevate our social media presence for Uber in India and Sri Lanka.
  

  

You will work closely with cross\-functional partners to bring new products, partnerships (comms, marketing and policy), campaigns, owned programming and events to life on our channels. This role requires excellent written and verbal communication skills, iPhone shooting and editing skills, an eye for graphic design, thumb\-stopping content ideas, and the ability to thrive in a fast\-paced environment.
  

  

**What You'll Do**  

  

  

* **Set the Social Strategy** : Develop, execute and launch the channel strategies for Uber and Uber Eats across Instagram, X/Twitter, YouTube, and emerging platforms. Manage day\-to\-day social media responsibilities for Uber India's consumer channel, earner's channel, and Uber Sri Lanka channel, which support both the mobility and delivery businesses.
* **Drive Cultural Relevance:** Identify trends, conversations, and opportunities where our brands can show up with POV, humor, speed, and creativity. Create culturally relevant, platform\-native ideas that tap into trends, moments, and consumer behavior in smart, strategic ways.
* **Create \& Lead Creators** : Shoot, edit, and create original content for new products, partnerships, and campaigns, as well as manage folks who will do the same. Ensure the work is cohesive, high\-quality, and consistently on brand.
* **Partner Internally \& Externally** : Collaborate with comms, marketing, policy, product, and external partners to align on messaging, visuals, and storytelling priorities.
* **Champion Experimentation** : take thoughtful risk\-taking, drive testing, and iteration to uncover new creative opportunities.

  

  

**Basic Qualifications**  

  

  

* 8\+ years of social\-first creative roles at brands, agencies, or media companies.
* Bachelor's degree
* A deep understanding of major social platforms (Instagram, X, LinkedIn, YouTube) and their respective audiences, features, and best practices.
* Proven track record building and scaling social channels with highly engaging, culturally relevant content.
* Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills.
Experience managing creators, influencers, contributors, or creative teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**  

  

  

* 10\+ years of social\-first creative roles at brands, agencies, or media companies.

* Strong creative instincts and ability to concept platform\-native ideas that ladder up to brand goals.
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, high\-visibility environment that requires both strategic thinking and hands\-on execution.
* A go\-getter who looks forward to rolling up their sleeves, building things from the bottom up, and excels in a fast\-paced environment.
* A creative strategist who can spot a trend from a mile away and leverages data\-driven insights to craft impactful, relevant content that aligns with Uber's business goals.
* A team player who enjoys working closely with cross functional stakeholders and stays calm under pressure. Success at Uber depends on the ability to partner internally and externally, and organize around shared goals.
* Communications, editorial planning, and graphic design / video editing experience.
* Influencer, creator and talent management experience.

title: Head Digital Marketing
description:
We are looking for an experienced, data-driven, and commercially focused Head of Digital Marketing to lead digital growth, customer acquisition, performance marketing, brand visibility, and revenue-focused marketing initiatives. Reporting To: CMO / CEO / Business Head 
 The role will own the end-to-end digital marketing charter, with direct accountability for customer acquisition, CAC, CPL, CPA, ROAS, conversion, customer quality, activation, retention, and revenue growth. 
 The ideal candidate will combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution and have a strong understanding of performance-led growth in FinTech, NBFC, Banking, Digital Lending , Payments, Insurance, or BFSI. The candidate should be comfortable working cross-functionally with Product, Sales, Technology, Risk, Analytics, and Compliance teams to build scalable and compliant digital acquisition engines. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 1. Digital Marketing & Growth Strategy Develop and own the overall digital marketing and growth strategy aligned with business, revenue, and customer acquisition objectives. Build an integrated digital roadmap across paid, organic, social, CRM, content, partnerships, and app/web channels. Identify new growth opportunities, customer segments, channels, and digital products to accelerate acquisition and revenue. Translate business objectives into measurable marketing plans, budgets, targets, and KPIs. 2. Performance Marketing & Customer Acquisition Lead performance marketing across Google, Meta, programmatic, affiliate, app marketing, and other relevant digital channels. Own customer acquisition metrics including CAC, CPL, CPA, ROAS, conversion rate, lead quality, activation, and disbursement/revenue. Develop scalable acquisition strategies across the complete customer funnel, from awareness and lead generation to application, approval, activation, and conversion. Continuously optimize channel mix, campaigns, audiences, creatives, bidding, landing pages, and budgets based on business performance. Drive efficient allocation of marketing budgets to maximize incremental revenue and customer value. 3. Growth, Funnel Optimization & CRO Own the digital customer journey and identify opportunities to improve funnel performance. Partner with Product and Technology teams to improve website/app conversion, application journeys, onboarding, and customer activation. Establish a structured A/B testing and experimentation framework across campaigns, creatives, landing pages, messaging, and customer journeys. Drive continuous improvement in conversion rates, activation, retention, and LTV/CAC. 4. SEO, Content & Organic Growth Develop and execute SEO and organic acquisition strategies to drive sustainable, high-quality traffic. Lead content strategy across website, landing pages, blogs, product content, and customer education. Improve organic visibility, rankings, traffic, and organic conversion. Build scalable content and SEO programs aligned with customer intent and business priorities. 5. Social Media & Brand Management Lead digital brand strategy and social media presence across relevant platforms. Build brand visibility, engagement, credibility, and customer trust. Ensure consistency of brand positioning and communication across paid and organic channels. Partner with creative and content teams to develop high-performing, insight-led campaigns. 6. CRM, Lifecycle Marketing & Retention Build and optimize CRM and lifecycle marketing programs across email, SMS, WhatsApp, push notifications, and other relevant channels. Develop customer journeys for lead nurturing, onboarding, activation, cross-sell, upsell, retention, and reactivation. Leverage customer data and segmentation to improve engagement, conversion, and lifetime value. Drive marketing automation and personalized communication at scale. 7. Analytics, Attribution & Marketing Intelligence Establish robust measurement frameworks across all digital channels and customer journeys. Own GA4, Google Tag Manager, conversion tracking, attribution, dashboards, and marketing analytics. Develop clear visibility into channel-level and campaign-level performance, customer quality, CAC, revenue, and ROI. Use data and customer insights to identify growth opportunities and make informed budget and channel decisions. Build a culture of experimentation, measurement, and accountability across the marketing function. 8. FinTech / BFSI Compliance & Risk Ensure all digital marketing, customer communication, campaigns, creatives, landing pages, and acquisition practices comply with applicable BFSI/FinTech regulations, internal policies, and brand guidelines. Work closely with Risk, Compliance, Legal, and relevant stakeholders to ensure compliant customer acquisition and communication. Balance growth objectives with customer protection, transparency, responsible marketing, and business risk requirements. 9. Team, Agency & Stakeholder Management Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing digital marketing and growth team. Manage external agencies, media partners, technology partners, affiliates, and other marketing vendors. Establish clear goals, ownership, performance standards, and review mechanisms for the team and partners. Collaborate closely with Product, Sales, Technology, Data/Analytics, Risk, Compliance, Finance, and Operations teams. Present marketing performance, insights, challenges, and growth plans to senior leadership. 
 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs): 
 Digital customer acquisition growth CAC / CPA / CPL reduction ROAS and Marketing ROI improvement Lead quality and lead-to-customer conversion Application, approval, activation, and disbursement growth Revenue generated through digital channels Website and app traffic and conversion Organic traffic, rankings, and SEO contribution Customer activation and retention LTV/CAC improvement Funnel conversion and drop-off reduction Marketing budget utilization and efficiency Digital brand awareness and engagement 
 Required Skills & Expertise: 
 Performance Marketing & Digital Growth Google Ads & Meta Ads SEO / SEM & Organic Growth Social Media & Digital Brand Management CRM & Marketing Automation GA4 & Google Tag Manager Attribution & Conversion Tracking A/B Testing, CRO & Growth Experimentation Affiliate & Partnership Marketing App & Web Marketing Customer Lifecycle & Retention Marketing Marketing Analytics & Data Interpretation Budget Planning, Allocation & Optimization Team, Agency & Vendor Management Strong commercial, analytical, leadership, and communication skills 
 Educational Qualification: 
 Bachelors degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Management, or a related field. MBA / PGDM in Marketing or a related discipline preferred. Relevant Digital Marketing / Analytics certifications preferred. 
 Experience:

title: Marketing Intern
description:
National Health Governance Council (NHGC) is an independent healthcare governance and policy platform working at the intersection of health policy, public health, healthcare delivery, technology and institutional reform . 
 NHGC brings together policymakers, Parliamentarians, healthcare leaders, clinicians, public-health experts, academia, industry, technology organisations and other stakeholders to facilitate meaningful dialogue and develop actionable perspectives on Indias healthcare priorities. 
 NHGCs work includes policy dialogues, roundtables, conferences, research, white papers, knowledge forums and stakeholder engagements across areas such as NCDs, healthcare access, financing, patient safety, digital health, AI, pharmaceuticals, diagnostics, medtech and resilient health systems. 
 About the Role 
 We are looking for a Marketing Intern who is creative, organised and interested in healthcare, policy, communications and digital media. 
 The intern will work closely with the NHGC team on digital communication, social media, event marketing and stakeholder communication . 
 This is a hands-on role where you will get exposure to how a healthcare policy and governance platform is built, communicated and positioned among senior stakeholders. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Social Media & Digital Marketing 
 Manage and maintain NHGCs social media handles, particularly LinkedIn and other relevant platforms. 
 Develop and schedule posts around NHGC initiatives, policy discussions, events and healthcare developments. 
 Assist in creating social media calendars and monthly content plans. 
 Coordinate with designers and content teams for creatives, posts, carousels and short-form content. 
 Track social media performance and prepare basic analytics reports. 
 Research relevant healthcare, policy and industry conversations for content opportunities. 
 Events & Event Marketing 
 Support marketing and communication for conferences, roundtables, policy dialogues and webinars . 
 Prepare event-related social media content before, during and after events. 
 Assist with speaker announcements, event reminders and post-event communication. 
 Coordinate with internal teams to ensure timely dissemination of event information. 
 Emailers & Communication 
 Draft and coordinate event emailers, invitations, reminders and follow-up communications . 
 Maintain email communication calendars for upcoming NHGC activities. 
 Assist in preparing stakeholder communication for policymakers, healthcare leaders, speakers and partners. 
 Support basic email campaign tracking and reporting. 
 Coordination 
 Coordinate with designers, content writers, event teams and external stakeholders. 
 Maintain content and communication trackers. 
 Ensure deadlines for social media posts, emailers and event communication are met. 
 
 
 
 Requirements Who We Are Looking For 
 Students or graduates from Marketing, Mass Communication, Journalism, Public Relations, Business, Healthcare Management or related fields . 
 Strong written and verbal communication skills. 
 Good understanding of social media platforms, particularly LinkedIn. 
 Comfortable with basic content writing and proofreading.

 Interest in healthcare, public policy, current affairs or social-impact initiatives will be an advantage.

 Benefits What You Will Learn
